item.title: Former Italian police chief found dead
item.description: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has expressed shock following the death of a former national police chief, whose body was found on Saturday. He had been under investigation over an alleged cover-up in an inquiry into a bombing linked to organised crime in Sicily. Jennie Shin reports. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Princess of Wales opens up about cancer
item.description: A new documentary titled Heal follows Britain’s Princess Catherine as she navigates life since her cancer diagnosis in 2024. The film tracks the 44-year-old as she attempts to climb the highest mountains in Scotland, England and Wales within 24 hours. In the trailer, she reflects on healing as a journey. Ophelie Jacobson reports. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: South Korea: AI cheating sparks exam security chaos
item.description: South Korea’s education minister resigned on Sunday following a major cheating scandal that erupted just ahead of the country’s university entrance exams. The controversy centred on the top scorer in a national tax accountant exam, who admitted to using a miniature camera and smartphone to secure a near-perfect result. Jack Pownall reports. Fuente: France 24 - English.
